case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You wrote that your family foundry takes pride in supplying us and values the long standing relationship. We feel the same, and we have not forgotten that you kept supplying us at the old price when it was hard for you. That is why we want to find a solution that is fair for both family companies.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

On the price history:
Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 132.33; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 133.08; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 134.57; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 90 days net.

Option A is the package we can approve. It lets your new price take effect and moves to a payment term that is clearly shorter than the other two, with a unit price below Options B and C.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

I would be glad if you took Option A to your own judgement as owner and let us know.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We are also willing to accept your proposed 45-day payment term to support our long-standing partnership. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

Our updated quote stands at a price of €138.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €135.40 per unit. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. 

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for taking our notice period point as a fair one, and for being willing to meet us on payment. That is the kind of partnership between two family companies that we want to keep, and we have not forgotten that you held the old price for us in a hard year.

Option A is the package we can approve. It keeps the payment term you were willing to accept, and it sets a price that is fair for both of us.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 132.33; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 132.22; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 14 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 133.08; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We would be glad to settle this together, as we have done for many years.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your cooperative approach and value the long-standing partnership between our family companies. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

As a matter of policy, we do not share internal cost breakdowns, but we are prepared to make a concession on price in exchange for faster payment. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. We therefore propose EUR 135.70 per unit for a 14-day payment term, valid from 1 April 2027.

For our complete current offer, we stand by a price of €135.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Option C: unit price EUR 129.04; new price valid from 2026-11-01; payment 14 days net.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
